rationale: The fixed implementation extends the edge-emulation condition to cover source images whose width is below the 8-pixel block width or whose height is below the requested block height. The Logic section only generally states that the function checks whether emulation is required or motion-vector limits are exceeded and falls back to software. Both implementations perform such checks and can fall back to the software implementation; the text does not specifically state the added width/height boundary conditions or otherwise distinguish the fixed behavior.
